name: Ranked bars with retired/banned stamps
looks: A short horizontal bar chart ranks a handful of labelled values by percentage, bars growing from the left on an uneven stagger. A beat after the bars settle, a couple of the lower rows get a red, rotated rubber-stamp label ("RETIRED", "BANNED") slapped over them, while a small live readout in the corner keeps ticking a secondary value.
build: Bars scaleX 0 -> 1 from the left edge, staggered top to bottom with the top bar leading. The stamp is a rotated (-8 to -12 degrees) bordered label that scales in fast from 1.4x to 1x with a hard stop (no overshoot), landing with a thump. The corner readout updates on its own short interval, independent of the bars.
sound: A rising blip per bar as it grows, a heavy thud on each stamp landing.
prompt: Grow a short ranked bar chart from the left edge, each row labelled with a value, then slap a rotated rubber-stamp label over one or two of the lower-ranked rows a beat later, as a blunt, slightly comic verdict on them, while a small readout elsewhere keeps ticking independently.
